execute_command_sandbox: run a bash command inside a sandbox environment and return its output
read_file_sandbox: read the content of a file given its absolute path in a sandbox
list_dir_sandbox: list the contents of a directory with configurable traversal depth in a sandbox
write_file_sandbox: write or append text content to a file at an absolute path in a sandbox
grep_sandbox: search for pattern matches inside text files under a directory in a sandbox
